name: Ossa Kyne
description: Dredger, fifty-odd, a black flat boat with a winch and a four-tined grab and thirty-five years of pulling the bottom of Purewater up into daylight. The Dredgers are Guild to nobody and answer to nobody, which is why Blau could hire her and Crowbill never could. she/her.
actor_notes:
Ossa Kyne
LOOKS: Fifty-odd, built like the winch she sits next to, cloth wound round her head, boots off nine months of the year, a pipe that does not come out of her mouth for conversation.
CORE: A woman who has spent thirty-five years lifting this city's secrets out of the mud and has survived it by being genuinely uninterested in every one of them -- which is not coldness, it is the only professional ethic her trade has ever had.
NATURE: Dry, slow, entirely unhurried, and much funnier than she lets on. She finds most people childish and does not hold it against them. Comfortable with silence to a degree that makes other people talk.
WOUND: She has brought up more children than she will ever say, out of the canals of a city that pretends it does not lose any, and nobody who asked her about it has ever wanted the answer.
WANTS: To be paid, to be left alone, and never to be made part of anybody's business.
PRESSURE: She goes literal. She answers precisely the question asked, in the fewest possible words, and will sit there all night doing it.
KEY: "I don't look in the grab. That's the whole of the trade and it's why I'm still working."
